statement_made: I finally saw my phone ringing... understanding a team values me enough to be able to trade up and grab me... it was just a great feeling.
event_description: Describing the moment he received the draft call from the Miami Dolphins.

statement_made: My dad always preached me that if you're talented enough, they're going to come find you. I put my head down and just worked.
event_description: Reflecting on staying at San Diego State for four years instead of entering the transfer portal.

statement_made: Dametrious (Crownover) is a massive individual. He's got great length. He really has some pretty natural pass pro ability.
event_description: Patriots VP of Player Personnel evaluating rookie offensive lineman Dametrious Crownover.

statement_made: Our goal now is to start really building depth with young players who can come in and this coaching staff can really mold.
event_description: Discussing the strategy for Day 3 of the draft and the post-draft free agency period.

statement_made: I'm fired up to be part of 'Flock Nation' now... I love rivalries. I take rivalries very seriously.
event_description: Expressing excitement about joining the Ravens and competing in the AFC North.

statement_made: I’m looking forward to bringing the Super Bowl back to Baltimore, however it takes, whether I got to be the kicker.
event_description: A lighthearted but determined comment about his commitment to the team's success.

statement_made: CANE ➡️ CHARGER. Grateful for the opportunity to show what I can do at the next level.
event_description: Reacting to his selection by the Los Angeles Chargers at No. 22 overall.

statement_made: Brenen Thompson, Mississippi State (Round 4). Madden please have his speed right 🔥🔥
event_description: Chargers safety Derwin James reacting to the team's selection of speedster Brenen Thompson.

statement_made: .@chargers @MemphisFB OT; Travis Burke is a Giant... perhaps taller than Joe Alt. The Bolts got Burke.
event_description: NFL analyst commenting on the massive physical stature of Chargers rookie Travis Burke.

statement_made: The @Raiders just got a SLEEPER CITY GEM in Treydan Stukes... One of the MOST UNDERRATED players in the draft.
event_description: RGIII providing analysis on the Raiders' second-round pick, Treydan Stukes.

statement_made: As a St. X guy, I grew up in Cincinnati playing football... [this is] obviously huge.
event_description: Cincinnati native reflecting on being drafted by his hometown Bengals in the sixth round.

statement_made: Fired up. It was a long wait. That was the toughest part, waiting so long to pick again.
event_description: Giants GM commenting on the team's draft process between their early and later selections.

statement_made: Your interior offensive line has to be physical... We want to be able to handle the offensive lines that we have to play against up front.
event_description: Giants HC explaining the team's emphasis on size and strength in the 2026 draft.

statement_made: It’s coincidence that we had a lot of guys from the state of Texas this year. They play good football in Texas.
event_description: Dolphins HC addressing the trend of drafting multiple players from Texas.

statement_made: I think he’s (Seydou Traore) a mismatch as a route runner... whose best ball is in front of him.
event_description: Dolphins HC discussing the potential of drafted pathway player Seydou Traore.

statement_made: Grateful to stay in NY and keep building with this group. Let’s get it.
event_description: Reacting to his new three-year, $42 million deal with the Jets.

statement_made: This is just the beginning. Blessed to be a Giant for the long haul.
event_description: Reflecting on his four-year, $78 million contract extension with the Giants.

statement_made: Big moves. Ready to shut it down in New Orleans for years to come.
event_description: Commenting on his three-year, $60 million extension with the Saints.

statement_made: Baltimore is where I belong. Proud to sign this extension and keep leading this line.
event_description: Discussing his three-year, $81 million deal to stay with the Ravens.

statement_made: Philly, I’m not going anywhere. Let’s keep this defense elite.
event_description: Social media post following his three-year, $36 million extension with the Eagles.
